status: FROZEN before training. Exactly six arms. No O2/O3/H3/C1 or exploratory arms in this first persistence screen.
intervention_mechanism: Each arm runs the frozen stabilize.run_arm loop with at most one interventions.py function swapped IN MEMORY (files on disk unchanged, hashes verified), plus, for H1/H2, a training-only optimizer/loss augmentation that touches no inference path. R0/A+ run unswapped.

A+.role: frozen window-only control REQUIRED by the relative causal-collapse threshold post_ablation <= max(A+ + 0.03, 0.05)

O1.role: correct-slot objective reproduction anchor (confirms transient-addressing phenotype on fresh seeds)
O1.coefficient_schedule: R0 lambda schedule (0.10 steps 1-300, linear 0.10->0 over 301-600, 0 for 601-1200)

O1R.role: standing residual correct-slot objective (tests whether persistent supervision prevents decay)
O1R.objective: O1 during the original scaffold PLUS lambda_address = 0.01 constant for steps 601-1200
O1R.mechanism: swap interventions.alignment_loss := objectives_persistence.o1r_correct_slot_loss with a residual-window floor
O1R.pass_rule: does NOT pass merely by retaining correct-slot probability; MUST retain causal collapse under BOTH frozen ablations at step 1200

H1.role: routing-parameter consolidation (tests protection from gradient overwrite)
H1.mechanism: 0.1x base LR on the frozen H1 addressing parameter group during steps 600-900 (see h1_parameter_group_manifest.json)
H1.pass_caveat: must preserve STRONG routing + acceptable quality, not freeze a weak circuit

H2.objective: R0 objective + schedule UNCHANGED, plus a training-only distillation to a step-600 teacher of the address-conditioned slot-read distribution
guardrails: no answer-label / needle-correctness / classifier / final-logit-answer leakage
